description: Siniestros Viales Palmira is a series of datasets listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Siniestros viales en el municipio de Palmira con vigencia 2024. Coverage: Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are alcaldia de palmira, transito, siniestralidad, vial, palmira. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
